parameters.content:
## Receive

One turn per call: sessionId, transcript, ASR confidence.

## Load state

The session row and the market row are the only state the model sees.

## Reason

PrepareTurn rebuilds the system prompt from facts and applies the yes/no gates. The agent has three tools, Postgres memory and a structured parser with auto-fix.

## Guard

Code decides: no booking claim without a code, caller-request rule, gate advance, handover line. Handoff builds the Refer-To here.

## Respond

Session update, event row, the reply the gateway speaks.

## AR-02 Dialogue turn

The brain. State lives in ar_sessions; the system prompt is rebuilt every turn. Guards after the model: no booking claim without a confirmation code, no slot that was not offered, no end before WRAPUP.

## Tools

FindDealers, FindSlots, BookAppointment. sessionId is plumbed, never a model parameter. Handoff is not a tool: it is a deterministic consequence of action=handoff.

meta.description: POST /webhook/ar/v1/session/turn. One call per caller utterance. Loads the session, runs the dialogue agent with its three tools, applies deterministic guards, builds the handoff context when needed, updates the session and logs. Returns speak, action, state and handoff.
